compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from an application related to NBA lineups. The main contents and functions of this screen are as follows:

1. **Title Bar**: The top section displays the title "LINEUPS" with a back arrow on the left and an information icon on the right.
2. **Date and Slate Selection**: Below the title bar, there is a section titled "Select your slate" with the date "NBA Mar 27, 2017".
3. **Game Slates**: The main content area lists different game slates with their respective times and number of games:
   - "Main, 6 Games" at 11:30 PM GMT+00:00
   - "Turbo, 2 Games" at 12:00 AM GMT+00:00
   - "Late, 3 Games" at 12:30 AM GMT+00:00
   - "Later, 2 Games" at 02:30 AM GMT
